n01.roman: Motor Vehicles Act ki dhaara 183: car jaisi light motor vehicle se speed limit todi, to jurmana kam se kam 1,000, aur 2,000 rupaye tak.

n02.roman: Truck ya bus jaisi bhaari gaadi? 2,000 se 4,000 rupaye.

n03.roman: Twist: 2019 ke sanshodhan se pehle, yahi jurmana sirf 400 rupaye tak tha!

n04.roman: Aur doosri baar pakde gaye? To driving licence impound, yaani zabt hoga.

n05.roman: Aur GTA jaisi sadak par race? Dhaara 189: pehli baar mein 3 mahine tak jail, ya 5,000 jurmana, ya dono. Dobaara: 1 saal tak jail, ya 10,000 jurmana, ya dono.
